recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future PackagedProductDefinition wording or modeling changes should be handled under their own Jira keys; FHIR-31804's Quantity-only type change is already complete.
issue_request: FHIR-31804 was a Published/Persuasive BR&R change request for MedicinalProductPackaged/PackagedProductDefinition asking that containedItem.amount stop being a Quantity|integer choice and instead be restricted to Quantity only.
initial_application: The current branch ancestry includes 6be46080f6, which explicitly changed PackagedProductDefinition.package.containedItem.amount[x] from Quantity|integer to PackagedProductDefinition.package.containedItem.amount with only Quantity for FHIR#31804. The Jira comments also record that the change was applied in both the R4B branch and main build.
additional_context: The active current resource is PackagedProductDefinition, and source/fhir.ini lists it in build scope. Later history renamed the path from package to packaging in FHIR-29692 and added published clarifications in FHIR-39130 and FHIR-39128; those changes explain the current path and wording while preserving the Quantity-only type.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current StructureDefinition defines PackagedProductDefinition.packaging.containedItem.amount without [x] and with one type, Quantity, so the requested source state is already present.
